company.shortDescription: OS3 develops custom software, websites, mobile apps, AI integrations, UX/UI design, and outsourcing services for businesses.
company.description: OS3 develops custom software solutions that support business processes across web and mobile platforms. The company creates corporate websites and native or multiplatform mobile applications for iOS and Android. OS3 offers development with artificial intelligence, integrating products with platforms such as OpenAI GPT, Bing AI, and Azure AI. It provides UX and UI design services for websites, mobile applications, and other digital interfaces. OS3 delivers outsourcing and team allocation services to extend client development capabilities. The company also works on CRM evolution through partnerships, advertising solutions, and monitoring tools under its own product brands.
